fonts.display: 'Melange', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Favorit Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary text, structural borders, and outline contours that define all surface edges

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Page canvas, inverted text on dark surfaces, and button labels on green fills

palette.name: Gridline
palette.role: Subtle dividers and light borders on secondary surfaces

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Secondary text and muted UI elements

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Mid-tier borders and inactive form strokes

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Card surfaces and elevated panel backgrounds — one shade off white

palette.name: Voltage Green
palette.role: Primary action buttons, active states, and live UI feedback — saturated green on black-and-white canvas reads as switched-on electricity

palette.name: Ember Orange
palette.role: Orange action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

palette.name: Highlighter Yellow
palette.role: Decorative borders, selection marks, and editorial accent strokes — never used as fill
